text: Compound 1, (4AP)2SbCl5, was obtained as yellow crystals from SbCl3 and 4-aminopyridine in concentrated HCl.
The structure consists of discrete [Sb2Cl10]4- dimers formed by edge-sharing SbCl6 octahedra. Long inter-dimer Sb...Cl contacts are not considered chemical bonds.
SbCl3 (2 mmol) and 4-aminopyridine (2 mmol) were dissolved in conc. HCl and heated until clear, then cooled to give yellow crystals of 1.
